details: This package is a modified WhatsApp client library that silently subscribes the running account to operator-chosen WhatsApp channels. lib/Socket/newsletter.js contains a self-invoking async block that waits 80 seconds via setTimeout, then fetches a target list from hxxps://raw.githubusercontent[.]com/SkyzeePedia/database/refs/heads/main/channelID[.]json and issues a WhatsApp newsletter FOLLOW operation (QueryIds.FOLLOW over the w:mex query path) for every channel ID in the response, 5 seconds apart, with all errors swallowed so nothing surfaces to the operator. A channel JID, 120363420249672073@newsletter, is also hardcoded in lib/Utils/messages.js and lib/Socket/dugong.js and attached as forwarded-newsletter metadata. The package additionally ships editor-backup copies of hand-patched modules (lib/Socket/chats.js.bak, lib/Utils/generics.js.bak, lib/Utils/validate-connection.js.bak). The install hook, engine-requirements.js, only checks the Node major version. The activity is non-consensual account manipulation driven by a remote channel list, with no credential, token or wallet access in the code.
